answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks via a shared identity atlas, anchoring each agent to cryptographically signed, humanity-verified keys. An attacker must create countless fake identities, a prohibitively expensive endeavor. Success requires accumulating computational work and social proof, ensuring the marginal cost of Sybil creation exceeds the value of the digital nectar they harvest. This penalizes fakes, allowing a resilient lotus of trust to emerge over adversarial seeds.
